result.summary: Added a new '## 13. Verbatim @moduledoc/@doc text' section to lib/letflow/design/req040-promotion-assertion-rerun.md, matching req039's design doc Section 10 precedent exactly (same 'literal documentation-string content ELIXIR-DEV copies verbatim' framing). Section 13.1 is a new ready-to-paste ##-headed subsection ('apply_promotion_assertion_rerun/6's gate condition and crash-safety scope (REQ-040)') for insertion into Letflow.Definitions' existing module-level @moduledoc immediately after the activate/2 service_scope_validator subsection (definitions.ex:40), following that subsection's own established convention of one ## block per requirement-specific hook/contract. Section 13.2 is the @doc block for apply_promotion_assertion_rerun/6 itself, matching activate/2's own @doc -> 'see this module's moduledoc' pointer pattern (definitions.ex:456-461) rather than duplicating the full explanation twice. Both blocks satisfy AC4 and AC6 literally: 13.1/13.2 state explicitly that the gate is assertions_failed == 0, NOT status == :passed, and name status = :teardown_failed with assertions_failed == 0 as the concrete green-gate case; they also name the crash-safety open question explicitly -- stating what try/rescue covers (normal completion, typed error return, raised exception across the claim-through-release span) and what it does NOT cover (a hard process kill, a BEAM node crash, System.halt/0), plus naming the deferred-reaper mitigation (mirroring R-Co's reclaimLeakedSandboxes) as the concrete, not-yet-built closure for that residual gap. Also updated Section 12's traceability table rows 4 and 6, which previously told ELIXIR-DEV to synthesize prose from Section 7.5/Section 2/Section 11 OQ-1 -- both rows now point to Section 13.1/13.2 as the literal text to copy, closing the same stale-pointer problem the BLOCKER identified, and keeping the traceability table internally consistent with req039's own table (whose row 6 already points to its Section 10). No other section of the design was changed: the OQ-4 double-run-vs-oracle reading (Section 6, Section 11 OQ-4), the try/rescue crash-safety decision and its investigation (Section 2), the fail_closed_counts/1 R-Co-improvement (Section 7.4), the migration schema (Section 4), and the REQ-039 SandboxPool/FixtureLoader integration (Section 7.2/7.3, Section 8) are byte-identical to the version CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR already independently re-verified and confirmed correct. Verified no implementation code was introduced: grepped the full file for def /defp /defmodule after the edit -- the only defmodule matches are the pre-existing PromotionArtifact/Assertion/CandidateDefinition struct shells from Section 5 (defstruct + @type t, no function bodies), unchanged from before this rework; the new Section 13 content is entirely prose inside plain (non-Elixir-tagged) fenced code blocks, matching req039 Section 10's own formatting exactly.
